title: Pride Slimes
description: This resourcepack changes the slimes into many different pride flags!
body:
This resourcepack adds a some pride flags into the minecraft world through slimes!

![A bunch of Pride Themed Slimes!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/688a7af7624a8845f9f82f36a2fb4985f606d42f_0.webp)

There are 24 different flags in here, and you can DM me on reddit (u/IJustAteABaguette) if you have any that you miss!

There are also 2 item changes!

![A Rainbow-Pride slimeblock and slimeball](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90f18e99a7da376e10136fe18671af1f3a92ff48.png)
